currentCard.explanation: Пальто — предмет верхней одежды, который носят поверх основного комплекта. Merriam-Webster описывает coat как верхнюю одежду для верхней части тела, длина и стиль которой зависят от моды и назначения.

literal.prompt: Какой из этих предметов одежды обычно относят к верхней одежде?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS in the explicit ordinary-category framing: Пальто is the familiar outerwear class, positively supported by COAT noun1a L48 and kids1 L172. The other Russian labels name the blouse, shirt and knitted sweater categories; their ordinary Russian wardrobe names are not the coat/outerwear class. The wording обычно относят asks for customary classification rather than whether a garment can ever be worn as the outermost layer. Thus a sweater worn outdoors does not supply a competing customary class answer. This is a semantic judgment about the full Russian row, not an inference that English dictionary entries prohibit particular uses or a claim about technical apparel standards.

The row does not ask about all senses of English blouse.
